body_html:
Snuck in a bit of time as the media query was annoying me on the collections page. After messing with my grid for too long, finding some critical mistakes, I realized I just needed to set a different image size on a background. I think using fr I can get away with no media queries. This is a huge step for me in terms of Keep it DRY. I rely on explicit grids just because my brain still needs the 1:1 reference to a Cartesian scale metaphor. Yet I ended up writing every grid cell twice, wasn't fun.

May have turned a corner. We will see.
